draft.how_matches_were_made: Matched on shared words. Each sentence is lowercased, stripped of its LaTeX and of the everyday words the whole book uses, and what is left is reduced to a rough stem so 'fractions' and 'fraction' count as one word. A shared word is worth 1 divided by the number of candidates that use it, so a word only one candidate uses decides a match and a word all of them use decides nothing. A total of 1.0 or more is a match. Every match lists the words that produced it.

learning_objectives: Round numbers to the nearest hundred or decimal place.
Convert between different units of length, weight, volume and capacity.
Work with fractions of quantities and mixed numbers.
Calculate perimeter, area and volume of simple shapes.
Perform multiplication and division with compound units.

said.says: This chapter reviews measurement conversions, fractions, ratios, geometry, and arithmetic with compound units for Year 5.
You will round whole numbers to the nearest hundred.
You will round decimals to one decimal place.
You will change yards, feet, and inches.
You will change pounds and ounces.
You will change gallons, quarts, and cups.
You will find a fraction of a quantity.
You will find a whole from a known fraction.
You will solve ratio problems with rectangles.
You will find perimeter, area, and volume.
You will multiply and divide compound units.
